text:
alice: FYI prod eu-embed cluster returning 503s from two pods since 11:42. Latency spike + error rate in grafana. I have a tiny config hotfix branch ready (v2.3.4-hotfix). Need rapid approval to push.
ben: How severe? customer impact?
alice: ~8% of embed requests failing on eu1, mostly short requests. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/eu-embed/alerts (errors up ~12%)
priya: Do we have a safe rollback if this goes sideways? what changed in v2.3.4-hotfix?
mateo: It's just a cache TTL bump and a routing fallback precedence fix (1-line change). Rollback is immediate: revert to v2.3.3 image. No schema changes.
ops-oncall: We're in weekday midday window — ops can approve expedited when two engineers + oncall sign off. Is canary feasible?
alice: Canary would route 5% traffic to new revision, but that still hits the embedding infra and customers. Given small change, proposing fast-pin: canary -> monitor 3m -> promote to 100% if no regressions. Need two +1s.
ben: +1 from me if ops-oncall and priya ok. Add explicit rollback criteria (errors >1% over baseline or p95 >200ms).
priya: +1. Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.3.3 --namespace=eu1` and tagging: `deployctl rollback --service embed --to v2.3.3`. I'll run if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
alice: /deploy start eu1 embed v2.3.4-hotfix --canary=5 --note "midday embed 503 hotfix"
deploy-bot: Received deploy request for eu1/embed -> v2.3.4-hotfix. Canary 5% (3 pods). Starting rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary pods started: embed-v2.3.4-hotfix-rc-1 (10s), embed-v2.3.4-hotfix-rc-2 (12s), embed-v2.3.4-hotfix-rc-3 (14s). Healthchecks running.
priya: Monitoring checks in place. I'll watch error rate and p95.
mateo: Release note snippet: ```Release: v2.3.4-hotfix
- Fix: routing precedence to prevent nil lookup -> mitigates 503s
- Config: increase cache TTL for small payloads```
deploy-bot: Canary health: OK (error rate 0.1% vs baseline 0.2, p95 85ms). Observed traffic routed successfully.
ops-oncall: Given health & rollback plan, approved to promote to 100% after 3m stable. I authorize expedited pin.
alice: /deploy promote eu1 embed v2.3.4-hotfix --to=100 --reason "canary green, ops approved"
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Shifting traffic to embed v2.3.4-hotfix -> target 100%. Progress: 40% -> 70% -> 100%. Logs: `shift succeeded`
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: embed v2.3.4-hotfix is now serving 100% in eu1. Link: https://deploys.redwood/commit/abcdef
alice: Thanks all — monitoring for 30m, will file quick release note and incident if anything pops.
ben: Nice job. Closing thread unless we see issues.
